name: heat-exchanger-design-tool
description: 🏭 Design efficient Shell & Tube heat exchangers with our robust tool, ensuring mechanical validation and accurate commercial quoting for your projects.

paragraphs: The heat-exchanger-design-tool is a user-friendly web-based application designed for HVAC engineers. This tool helps you design effective heat exchangers efficiently. Whether you are a seasoned engineer or new to the field, this application will simplify your design process.
features: Intuitive Interface: Navigate easily through the application.
Comprehensive Calculations: Perform detailed thermal analyses without confusion.
Interactive Design: Visualize your designs in real time.
Multiple Types of Heat Exchangers: Choose from various designs to match your project needs.
Data Export: Download your design files in commonly used formats.
